description: 한국가스공사_도시가스 공급열량실적 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국가스공사. 도시가스의 공급열량실적을 조회할 수 있는 데이터로 도시가스회사별 저위발열량(MJ기준, Kcal 기준 각각), 고위발열량(MJ기준, Kcal 기준 각각)의 항목을 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국가스공사. Its tags are 도시가스 공급열량실적, 도시가스회사별, 저위·고위발열량, 산업고용. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2024-10-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
